ik.method: Synthetic multi-phase bounded IK followed by fixed-stance refinement; not recorded human motion. Offline SciPy 1.16.3; runtime uses checked frozen joint targets and native mj_step.
ik.wrist_basis: Native elbow and proximal wrist anchors; forearm shaft expressed in hand frame, projected onto native hand longitudinal/dorsal plane. This is a geometric proxy, not calibrated clinical ROM.
ik.unchanged: All other native joint ranges, internal equalities, muscle strengths/curves, body mass/inertia.

support_guides.vertical_motion: free; normal support remains unilateral native floor contact
support_guides.friction_check: native contact cones plus aggregate Coulomb bound for each hand/foot; no pressure-map claim

hands.source: pinned MS-Human-700-Manipulation.xml right articulated hand and native mirrored left meshes
hands.finger_dynamics: rigid posture; no independent finger integration or grip-force estimation
hands.left_posture: sagittal reflection of source right posture; native source mirrored meshes
hands.lengthrange: native manipulation-hand actuator length ranges where supplied; unchanged source maximum forces
hands.wrist_ligaments: unavailable: no discrete ligament elements in the pinned model
hands.tendon_mechanics: native muscle-tendon transmission paths; no independently deformable tendon tissue
hands.retained_hand_inertia: primary source hand mass/inertia, no mass from added display meshes

wrist_range_derivation.status: literature-informed engineering envelope; not subject calibrated
wrist_range_derivation.measurement: forearm shaft between native elbow/wrist anchors in native hand longitudinal/dorsal plane; geometric proxy, not clinical calibration

palm_reference_check.support_landmark: mean native palm pad centres projected onto the floor
palm_reference_check.longitudinal_band: between ipsilateral shoulder joint and caudal end of native Sternum mesh; body-relative floor heading
palm_reference_check.interpretation: Broad engineering rejection checks, not registered human kinematics or clinical norms. Legacy reach is retained for reproducibility and must fail placement.

controller.assistance: bounded external residual after actual muscle force
controller.gravity_feedforward: least-squares static load sharing; predicted loads are not measured pressures
controller.muscle_allocation: 300 projected accelerated-gradient iterations, bounds [0,1], ridge 1e-5; 100 Hz
controller.reference: 0.2 s settle, 4 s sine-squared flexion cycle, 0.2 s hold

source_scientific.scope: Standard-width palms at chest level, 31 cm between supports, with a synthetic full-amplitude reference from 0.1 to 1.9 rad elbow flexion. Only two wrist extension coordinate bounds differ from the source model, using a separately declared literature-informed envelope; geometric shaft extension is checked at every step. This is not subject calibration or evidence of pure muscle-driven control. Earlier chest_level partial motion and legacy_reach remain explicit for archive replay. Full primary 700-muscle body with source-derived rigid palms finger posture, genuine detailed hand meshes and 48 source hand transmissions. Wrist dynamics and multi-point hand contacts are measured. Prescribed sticking points prevent horizontal support drift; native floor normals remain unilateral. Bounded external residual joint assistance stabilizes the engineering reference; this is not pure muscle-driven control, finger dynamics or ligament tissue simulation. Read separate acceptance gates.
limitations: Model-specific musculotendon geometry; no population normative or patient-specific claims.
No organ, disc pressure, spinal cord, breathing, injury risk, or medical safety predictions.
No equilibrium controller, gait policy, observed motion replay, or human force validation.
Numerical consistency is not experimental or clinical validation; wrapping branches can be nonsmooth.
Synthetic engineering reference and bounded recruitment feedback; not measured human motion or a validated neural controller.
Added massless spherical palm/toe contact pads and plane; these are mechanical proxies, not inferred anatomical tissue or flat-palm pressure.
Source self-collision retained; source visual bones do not provide complete tissue collision coverage.
Added internal viscous damping floor 10 N*m*s/rad (hinges), 10 N*s/m (slides); this changes passive mechanics and dissipates energy.
Source shoulder/scapular joint equalities prescribe scapulohumeral coupling; scapular motion is not independently controlled.
All 700 native muscle dynamics/transmissions retained, but force parameters and recruitment are unvalidated for push-ups.
Model activation is dimensionless dynamical state, not surface EMG, percent MVIC, clinical strength or injury risk.
Native muscle-tendon paths are not muscle volumes; no external atlas registration or subject calibration.
Prescribed sticking points restrict horizontal motion; free vertical numerical guides preserve unilateral floor normals. This is an ideal boundary condition, not calibrated deformable skin friction.
Four unactuated 0.1 g vertical guides add small inertia/damping; actual guide reactions are included in force balance and aggregate per-limb Coulomb checks at every integration step.
Detailed hands use native manipulation meshes and muscle paths in rigid open/closed finger poses; no independent finger dynamics, ligament forces or tissue pressure.
Left posture mirrors the source right hand with native mirrored meshes; primary hand mass/inertia retained. Hand actuator length ranges use the manipulation source where provided.
Full palms use a separately declared wrist envelope and stance; palms/knuckles are not an isolated causal comparison.
Assisted muscle mode applies recorded bounded residual generalized joint torques in addition to genuine muscle forces; it is not pure muscle-driven dynamics.

Only two wrist-extension coordinate bounds differ from the pinned model; the separate whole-shaft angle is checked at every integration step. Literature motivates this engineering envelope but does not calibrate the model's oblique hinges, coupling, muscle curves, ligaments or participant anatomy.
